# Grafana documentation

> Grafana Labs builds open and composable observability software, including Grafana, Grafana Cloud, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope, Alloy, Beyla, Faro, and k6.

This file is the exhaustive documentation index for AI agents and other automated consumers.

Use this file when you want a broad inventory of Grafana Labs technical documentation in one place. For a shorter curated entrypoint, use [llms.txt](/llms.txt).

All links below point to machine-readable Markdown pages on `https://grafana.com`.

All Grafana documentation pages support a machine-readable Markdown form:
- Append `.md` to the canonical docs URL.
- Or request the canonical docs URL with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Documentation home

- [Technical documentation](https://grafana.com/docs.md): Grafana Labs technical documentation landing page.


## Copyright notice
- [Copyright notice](https://grafana.com/docs/copyright-notice.md): Technical documentation for Grafana Labs products and services.

## Grafana Agent Documentation
- [Grafana Agent Documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest.md): Grafana Agent is a telemetry collector for sending metrics, logs, and trace data to the opinionated Grafana observability stack. It works best with:
- [Flow mode](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow.md): Grafana Agent Flow is a component-based revision of Grafana Agent with a focus on ease-of-use, debuggability, and adaptability
- [Concepts](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow/concepts.md): Learn about the Grafana Agent Flow concepts
- [Clustering](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow/concepts/clustering.md): Learn about Grafana Agent clustering concepts

- [Components configuration language](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow/concepts/config-language/components.md): Learn about the components configuration language
- [Expressions](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow/concepts/config-language/expressions.md): Learn about expressions
